meta.name: alterlab-datamol
meta.description: Wraps RDKit in a high-level, pandas-friendly datamol interface with sensible defaults for everyday drug discovery — SMILES/SDF loading into DataFrames, molecule standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, Butina clustering, 3D conformer generation, scaffold analysis, and parallel batch processing, returning native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. Use when running standard cheminformatics pipelines on molecule tables with minimal boilerplate; for low-level control, custom sanitization, or specialized algorithms prefer alterlab-rdkit. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用 pandas 友好的方式处理药物发现中的分子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你日常处理分子表格，需要快速完成标准化、指纹和聚类。
copy.tagline_en: Process molecular data for drug discovery with a pandas-friendly interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely work with molecular tables and need fast standardization, fingerprints, and clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理分子数据：读取 SMILES/SDF 文件、标准化分子、计算描述符和指纹、进行 Butina 聚类、生成 3D 构象、分析骨架、应用化学反应，并支持并行批量处理。
howto.when: 当你要求处理分子表格（如 CSV、SDF 文件）或执行标准化学信息学流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这个 CSV 文件加载分子，并计算它们的 LogP 和分子量。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并计算描述符。

say.text: 对这组 SMILES 进行 Butina 聚类，阈值设为 0.3。
say.note: Claude 会执行聚类并返回簇索引。

say.text: 生成这些分子的 3D 构象，每个分子 50 个，并保存为 SDF。
say.note: Claude 会生成构象并输出文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process molecular data: read SMILES/SDF files, standardize molecules, compute descriptors and fingerprints, perform Butina clustering, generate 3D conformers, analyze scaffolds, apply chemical reactions, and support parallel batch processing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process molecule tables (e.g., CSV, SDF files) or run standard cheminformatics pipelines.

say_en.text: Load molecules from this CSV file and compute their LogP and molecular weight.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and compute descriptors.

say_en.text: Butina cluster these SMILES with a cutoff of 0.3.
say_en.note: Claude will perform clustering and return cluster indices.

say_en.text: Generate 3D conformers for these molecules, 50 each, and save as SDF.
say_en.note: Claude will generate conformers and output the file.
